help.card.desc: There are cards numbered 1 to 10, with 10 cards for each number.
help.end.desc:
The game ends when all the cards have been revealed and played.

All orthogonally adjacent cards with the same number cancel each other out and are removed from the game.

Count up the total value of the cards still in your grid.
<bold>The lowest score wins the game.</bold>
help.firstplayer.desc:
Starting with the player holding the First Player counter and continuing clockwise, each player chooses one of the cards revealed in the middle of the table and slides it into their grid from the outside.

At the end of the round, the First Player counter passes to the player on the left.
header.choose.players: Players must choose a face-down card
header.choose.me: You must choose a face-down card
header.choose.revealed.player: {player} must insert one of the cards into their grid
header.choose.revealed.me: You must insert one of the cards into your grid
tuto.tableau:
In Slide, each player has <bold>16 cards</bold> face down in front of them, forming a 4 by 4 grid.
This is your grid.
tuto.choose:
Each round, you must choose a <bold>face-down</bold> card from your grid.
Choose this card.
tuto.simultaneous: All players reveal the card they have chosen <bold>at the same time</bold>.
tuto.first:
This is the <bold>First Player counter</bold>.
It shows who will be first to choose a card to place in their grid.
tuto.expl:
You are the first player this round.
On your turn, you must choose one of the revealed cards and slide it into your grid.
tuto.insert:
To insert a card into your grid, it must push <bold>a row</bold> or <bold>a column</bold> to fill the empty space.
Here are the 3 possible locations this round.
tuto.play.1: Take this card and place it here.
tuto.first.change: Once every player has inserted a card, the First Player counter passes to the player on the left.
tuto.new:
A new round then begins. Each player must again choose a <bold>face-down</bold> card to reveal.
Choose this card.
tuto.opponent.first: Your opponent plays first this time.
tuto.play.2: It's your turn. Insert your card here.
tuto.end: The game is played over 16 rounds, until all the cards have been revealed.
tuto.goal:
Your aim is to place cards with the same number side by side.
At the end of the game, <bold>all adjacent cards with the same number cancel each other out</bold> and are removed from the game.
tuto.score: The player with <bold>the fewest points</bold>, counting the total value of their remaining cards, <bold>wins the game</bold>.
tuto.go: Now it's your turn to play. Good luck!
